annotations.title: QE Virtual AI Machine: one liquidity machine per country, its money pipes and the exact repair of each one

description: The OwlChart QE Virtual AI Machine (v5.910), one machine per country, each read only from that country's own institutions. what=countries (the World board: 35 countries in a fixed order, the United States, the 27 members of the European Union, then the United Kingdom, Japan, China, Georgia, Ukraine, Russia and Iran; each with its gauge from 0 to 100 or no gauge, its word DRYING, TURNING or FLOODING, how many of its wired pipes are flowing, the date of its latest report, and the scoring formula). With country= a two letter code (us, de, fr, es, it, pl, gb, jp, cn, ge, ua, ru, ir and the other members of the European Union): what=now (the gauge, the word, the counts, two plain sentences, the latest and the next report, the formula), pipes (that country's own pipes, each tagged national or euro-area shared, with its source, official page, series, raw value, date and raw data link; a pipe whose national source is not wired is grey and names the office it waits for; globalOverlay holds stablecoins, Bitcoin funds and gold, which are never counted in any gauge), repairs (what would turn each leaking pipe green and the next date), log (reports that changed a pipe), brief, history (one reading a day). what=wars (the two wars of the Global overlay, Middle East and oil, Russia and Ukraine with gas and food: the world prices and the repair orders, who holds each lever and the proof; shown on every country and never counted in a number). what=method (the exact scoring formula, weights, freshness limits). A country shows a number only when every one of its own pipes has a fresh signal; otherwise it reads being wired. Data only, not advice.
